items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: Danny Thompson, by the way, was kind of like the head salesman for Sun Ra’s record label. He was also the baritone player and kind of the point man for a lot of things with the band. Very nice guy.

ctx.x: Well, ensuring the scarcity of so many of them obviously.

So I mean just as wacky as everything else they had done you know. “We don’t have that one anymore.” Danny Thompson, by the way, was kind of like the head salesman for Sun Ra’s record label. He was also the baritone player and kind of the point man for a lot of things with the band. Very nice guy. He died about two years ago now. And he — people started calling him Danny “Ray” Thompson. Originally it was just Danny Thompson, then he was like Danny Ray, and now he’s always referred to as Danny Ray Thompson. But…
So were the records being delivered in handmade sleeves, was there a standard actual sleeve for these titles or they were only issued in handmade sleeves?
